When faced with dire situations, just as Isaac faced, to whom do we turn to? Where do we go for help? In fact, who is our FIRST point of call at the sign of trouble beyond our control? The answers to these questions point to the state of our relationship with the Lord Jesus Christ. In Isaac’s situation, God interrupted him before he could think of going to Egypt like his father. Praise God, Isaac listened. Looking at the situation he was in, common sense would have dictated that he heads for a land not affected by the famine, even if it is Egypt. So many times, when we are faced with dire situations, we allow our ‘common sense’ to dictate to us; and we rationalize it by quoting Scriptures, for instance: "},{"type":"text","text":"“If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct”","marks":[{"type":"italic"}]},{"type":"text","text":" (Ecclesiastes 10:10, KJV)."}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Many out of haste, fear, impatience have moved from their secure positions of power and advancement in the Lord to positions of insecurity and the likes. If you do not agree with this, if I may ask you: how many times have you taken a path because it was ‘common sense’ (expedient), wise to do so at the time, only to realize a few steps down the path it was a wrong move? Beloved, like Isaac, it is true that the Lord had pronounced amazing promises to you concerning your life. But how is your obedience to His instructions? Do you only obey Him when it is convenient, and at other times, you obey your common sense and ‘wisdom is profitable to direct’ theory? The desire of God for us is that we will not only carry His Promises, we will carry His Fulfillment. When we remain in the place He wants us to remain, He blesses us – the Promise made to us is Fulfilled! But when we shift positions, the Promise is not fulfilled. It is like being pregnant without any hope of giving birth! Beloved, God didn’t change His mind, we moved!"}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Have you allowed the dictates of your needs, emotions or the circumstances you had found yourself caused you to move from where God placed you? Abraham moved and returned with Hagar – that move has remained a thorn in the flesh of his descendants to this day! Every time we move to where we had not been assigned to, there is always an ‘Hagar’ that dogs our steps going forward. Beloved, remain planted in Him and be moved by Him, not by your needs, emotions or the winds of circumstances you find yourself: "},{"type":"text","text":"“So don’t throw away your confidence which has a great reward. For you need endurance, so that after you have done God’s will you may receive what was promised”","marks":[{"type":"italic"}]},{"type":"text","text":" (Hebrews 10:35-36). Because Isaac obeyed and remained, he reaped a hundred fold harvests in a season that is said to be famine! God is set to do that which is impossible in our lives if we consistently remain and abide by His instructions. May the Lord grant us the Grace to remain in Him no matter the wind that is blowing around us, in Jesus Christ name! God bless you!"}]}]}

resources.title: A Lie Exposed!
resources.original_resource_body:
One of the greatest tricks the enemy ever pulled was to deceive man into thinking he does not really need God in certain aspects of his life. He started this deceit in the beginning, when he told the Woman: “’No! You will not die,’ the serpent said to the woman. In fact, God knows that when you eat it your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil’” (Genesis 3:4-5). This lie has made many wonderful children of God to erroneously place their hope in people, themselves, institutions and the likes with dire consequences, or to lose hope altogether. A young man once argued with a group of his friends that there were some things about the human race God does not bother Himself with. These things, according to him, have been left to our discretion. God has given us brains and wisdom to figure out some things for ourselves, and to take decisions based on our convictions. To buttress his point, he quoted: “The heavens are the Lord’s, but the earth He has given to the human race” (Psalm 115:16). Based on that Scripture he believes man has the authority to decide some things for himself! This argument is simply not true! 
       The earth given to man was for man to have dominion, be an ambassador of God on it so to say: “God blessed them, and God said to them, ‘Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Rule the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky and every creature that crawls on the earth” (Genesis 1:28). And for there to be harmony on the earth, God gave rules for us to live by. Every sin man commits is not against the things he is to dominate but against God and his fellow human being. That is why the whole instruction of God is summed up in ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and strength, and love your neighbor as yourself’. If one can do this successfully, then one is truly perfect. The Bible tells us: “The heavens, indeed the highest heavens, belong to the Lord your God, as does the earth and everything in it” (Deuteronomy 10:14). Also: “…This is so the living will know that the Most High is ruler over the kingdom of men. He gives it to anyone He wants and sets over it the lowliest of men” (Daniel 4:17b). This means no one comes to rule over a people without God’s say so. He owns the earth and all that is in it: “Everyone must submit to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those that exist are instituted by God” (Romans 13:1). At no point did the Lord surrender the ruler-ship or ownership of the earth to any of His created beings. When the devil claimed: “So he took Him up and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. The devil said to Him, ‘I will give You their splendor and all this authority, because it has been given over to me, and I can give it to anyone I want. If You, then, will worship me, all will be yours’” (Luke 4:5-7). It was not so from the beginning! The devil made this audacious claim because of the fall of man in the beginning. This is why the Bible tells us: “For You have put everything in subjection under his feet. Now in putting everything in subjection to man, He left nothing outside [of man’s] control. But at present we do not yet see all things subjected to him [man]” (Hebrews 2:9, AMP). 
       Because of lack of understanding of who they are and their stand as sons of God, many gave up hope concerning their situations. So many are hustling and running races that were never set for them. Some are in situations they should have gotten out of, if like Moses they realized what was in their hands. Sadly, many pray, but in their hearts they doubt if God will really come through for them. Beloved, that is a lie from the pit of hell. God is All Mighty and not Some Mighty. He is either the LORD of All or of none. But we KNOW He is the LORD of ALL: “The heavens are Yours, the earth also is Yours. The world and everything in it – You founded them” (Psalm 89:11). If He didn’t have a say on the happenings on the earth, He would not have asked us to pray thus: “Our Father in heaven, Your name be honored as holy, Your Kingdom come, Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven” (Matthew 6:9b-10). This means, we need to seek His will concerning all that pertains to us on earth and pray it to be because IT IS ALREADY SETTLED IN HEAVEN! 
       Beloved, do you know the will of God is for you to live in victory in all areas of your life? Sadly, many sons of God plan for pain and failure as if it is the will of God for them to live thus. You and I have a mandate to seek His will, not ours, and to pray it come to pass in our lives, family, communities and Nations. That which you seek, oh wonderful child of God, is not dead! Don’t listen to the evil whispering of darkness or the wicked threats of hell, the LORD Jesus Christ has risen for your defense and people will come to know that you are loved and highly favored of the Most High God, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ! God bless you!!!

resources.title: A Lie Exposed! Part 2
resources.original_resource_body:
Someone once said God yielded a bit of His sovereignty to man that is why we have freewill and can do whatever we want; after all we have brains and wisdom, he argued. That is a very faulty, deceptive and dangerous assumption. When God created mankind, He made us His ambassadors, deputy authorities, and deputy sovereigns upon the face of the earth. He told man to have dominion over every life form on the earth and subdue it. Man had his marching orders and mode of operation, he didn’t need the permission of God to operate. That was why man could name the animals without seeking permission from God to see if the names fit! The Bible says: “…And whatever the man called a living creature that was its name” (Genesis 2:19b). Even when the female came, the male part of man named her ‘woman’ because she was taken out of man. God did not dispute this. In fact God approved everything man did because man was speaking out the mind of God at every turn. Remember, man was deputy to God! 
      But man was tricked by the devil he was meant to subdue, and he lost his place in the scheme of things. When this happened, the position of man was taken by the devil and man became powerless, a shadow of whom he should be. Hence God had to come to reclaim that order back for man and redeem man to Himself (restoring the Fellowship He had with man in the Garden in the beginning). 
      Beloved, after the fall of man, things changed. Flesh began to rule man. Man no longer had the authority and dominion to do his work. Now, the authority and dominion can only be exercised through Jesus Christ. That was why man was told: “If you ask Me anything in My name [as My representative], I will do it” (John 14:14). Jesus Christ now stands as an intermediary or shield if you will, between man and the enemy. Therefore, man no longer have the absolute freedom to do as he pleases and still hope to reign with God: “…And those who are in the flesh [living a life that caters to sinful appetites and impulses] cannot please God” (Romans 8:8, AMP). Only those who live according to His dictates can please Him and reign with Him at the end. 
      Beloved, the rules changed because of the happenings of Genesis 3. Now man needs to seek out the will of God and do it. Don’t be deceived, our freedom is not reckless abandonment because of the fallen state of man, but a freedom that comes with responsibility in Christ Jesus! When we know and agree with this Truth we are free from the deceit of the enemy that seeks to enslave us and blind us to his shenanigans! We need to be acquainted even more so now with the Truth because of the great deception wind that is sweeping across the world. It is increasingly becoming difficult to discern the truth from the falsehood being peddled by the enemy and his agents. 
      Beloved, we now live in a time when the true sons (male and female) of God must stand up and be used on their different platforms to increase the knowledge of God across the globe. The enemy knows his time is short and he is equally pushing to cover the earth with his deception. This is the time we must see beyond the so obvious, and see what God is saying and doing in these times, so as to pray it into reality: “Your Kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven” (Matthew 6:10)! These are indeed the times we must KNOW by experience the God we claim to serve and not a version of what we think we know based on what we had been taught. It is ONLY when we KNOW Him in this manner are we able to fulfill the purpose why we are here. Understand this, like Esther, we have been put in the place we are, doing what we are doing for a time like this: “…But the people who know their God will be strong and take action” (Daniel 11:32b). So, STAND UP, Trust Him and begin to walk in, through and for Him – ASK Him, He will show you how; He is only a Prayer away! God bless you.

resources.normalized_resource_body:
Someone once said God yielded a bit of His sovereignty to man that is why we have freewill and can do whatever we want; after all we have brains and wisdom, he argued. That is a very faulty, deceptive and dangerous assumption. When God created mankind, He made us His ambassadors, deputy authorities, and deputy sovereigns upon the face of the earth. He told man to have dominion over every life form on the earth and subdue it. Man had his marching orders and mode of operation, he didn’t need the permission of God to operate. That was why man could name the animals without seeking permission from God to see if the names fit! The Bible says: “…And whatever the man called a living creature that was its name” (Genesis 2:19b). Even when the female came, the male part of man named her ‘woman’ because she was taken out of man. God did not dispute this. In fact God approved everything man did because man was speaking out the mind of God at every turn. Remember, man was deputy to God!

But man was tricked by the devil he was meant to subdue, and he lost his place in the scheme of things. When this happened, the position of man was taken by the devil and man became powerless, a shadow of whom he should be. Hence God had to come to reclaim that order back for man and redeem man to Himself (restoring the Fellowship He had with man in the Garden in the beginning).

Beloved, after the fall of man, things changed. Flesh began to rule man. Man no longer had the authority and dominion to do his work. Now, the authority and dominion can only be exercised through Jesus Christ. That was why man was told: “If you ask Me anything in My name [as My representative], I will do it” (John 14:14). Jesus Christ now stands as an intermediary or shield if you will, between man and the enemy. Therefore, man no longer have the absolute freedom to do as he pleases and still hope to reign with God: “…And those who are in the flesh [living a life that caters to sinful appetites and impulses] cannot please God” (Romans 8:8, AMP). Only those who live according to His dictates can please Him and reign with Him at the end.

Beloved, the rules changed because of the happenings of Genesis 3. Now man needs to seek out the will of God and do it. Don’t be deceived, our freedom is not reckless abandonment because of the fallen state of man, but a freedom that comes with responsibility in Christ Jesus! When we know and agree with this Truth we are free from the deceit of the enemy that seeks to enslave us and blind us to his shenanigans! We need to be acquainted even more so now with the Truth because of the great deception wind that is sweeping across the world. It is increasingly becoming difficult to discern the truth from the falsehood being peddled by the enemy and his agents.

Beloved, we now live in a time when the true sons (male and female) of God must stand up and be used on their different platforms to increase the knowledge of God across the globe. The enemy knows his time is short and he is equally pushing to cover the earth with his deception. This is the time we must see beyond the so obvious, and see what God is saying and doing in these times, so as to pray it into reality: “Your Kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven” (Matthew 6:10)! These are indeed the times we must KNOW by experience the God we claim to serve and not a version of what we think we know based on what we had been taught. It is ONLY when we KNOW Him in this manner are we able to fulfill the purpose why we are here. Understand this, like Esther, we have been put in the place we are, doing what we are doing for a time like this: “…But the people who know their God will be strong and take action” (Daniel 11:32b). So, STAND UP, Trust Him and begin to walk in, through and for Him – ASK Him, He will show you how; He is only a Prayer away! God bless you.

resources.title: Time To Know Christ And Him Crucified!
resources.original_resource_body:
At a point in his ministry, Apostle Paul was in Athens where his spirit was vexed and provoked because of the numerous idols the people of the city worshiped (Acts 17:16-33). The amazing thing about the Athenians and the foreigners that lived among them is that they loved to listen to and debate new ideas on a daily basis: “Now all the Athenians and the foreigners residing there spent their time on nothing else but telling or hearing something new” (Acts 17:21). One could argue that the time we live in presently is not too different from the said Athenian society. Many today love to hear new things and debate them daily. Like the Athenians that gather in their Areopagus, we have the Social Media Verse to hear and debate new things. Even our Churches and Fellowships are not left out. It is good to be curious, but in our curiosity and quest to know new spiritual things, it will be tragic to leave the important things we should be curious and seek to know about and go chasing things that are of no eternal value to us on the long run as sons of God. 
      Many children of God know men of God, know their denominations, doctrines but are not too conversant with the God they claim to serve. If there was ever a time to know and be well acquainted with our God, it is NOW! This is the time we must know Christ as our personal Lord, and Him crucified - what it means. Knowing this will help us live lives of Kingdom impact, and in preparation for His Return. To successfully know Him, there is a mindset we must have to live to please Him in this life and in preparation to reign with Him when He returns: “And He died for all, so that all those who live might live no longer to and for themselves, but to and for Him Who died and was raised again for their sake” (2 Corinthians 5:15, AMP). Beloved, the Life of Christ is not a FAD to be debated to see how we can fit it to our own lives! 
      When we gave our lives to Him, we are compelled daily by the Holy Spirit to take on His life, denying/crucifying ours in order to live daily to please Him, because that is the ONLY way to escape and live above the corruption of this world. To truly claim to KNOW Him, we must crucify the Flesh in us. The Flesh is the mindset of living apart from God (Romans 7:7-25)! This mindset (Flesh) was not acquired but born in and with us: “Indeed, I was guilty when I was born; I was sinful when my mother conceived me” (Psalm 51:5). Thus, it must DIE for us to live the Life of Christ: “Now those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires” (Galatians 5:24). Also, “For the mind-set of the flesh is hostile to God because it does not submit itself to God’s law, for it is unable to do so. Those whose lives are in the flesh are unable to please God” (Romans 8:7-8). Don’t be deceived, the flesh and the Spirit of God cannot co-exist. This means, if you claim to be Born Again but you still indulge in the works of the flesh (Galatians 5:16-21), your good confession is a LIE! 
      How then do we put Mr Flesh to death? The ONLY way is to surrender it at the foot of the Cross to be destroyed and uprooted from our lives just like a stubborn son (Deuteronomy 21:18-21). Don’t be deceived, Flesh cannot be reasoned with, quieted, counseled, trained or hidden. It must be crucified! Christ came to abolish the works of darkness and turn us back to Him. Have you ever wondered where the works of darkness are? Jesus taught everyday for three and a half years on the face of the earth. This is to tell us that these works that He came to expose, abolish and destroy are anchored in the souls of people! His coming was not just to heal us of all our diseases, feed us and prosper us. If these were the only reasons He came, He didn’t need to have come because Moses, Elijah, Elisha and many other prophets did the same. But they could not help the people take out Flesh. The laws could not accomplish the desired results because of it (Romans 7:13-25). That was why Christ had to come and die so that Mr Flesh can die permanently! 
      We cannot play the hypocrite or pretend anymore! The Return of Christ for His Bride is closer now than when we first believed. It is time, to go out of your way to KNOW HIM FOR YOURSELF, and He will teach You Himself: “The anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you don’t need anyone to teach you. Instead, His anointing teaches you about all things, and is true and is not a lie; just as it has taught you, remain in Him” (1 John 2:27). God bless you as you surrender your life to Him afresh!

resources.title: Watch Your Decision Making
resources.original_resource_body:
“Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the Lord is near in the valley of decisions” (Joel 3:14). 
      We bless the name of the Lord for giving us the grace to see yet another year. To Him be All the glory! Beloved, welcome to the year of our Lord! As it normally is, many are in the process of making plans, decisions, arrangements, alliances and many more for the year. One thing is for sure though; the previous year had turned so many things upside down, such that what was readily known by experience is no longer the case. One could say it is as if the world has entered an era of a ‘new normal’! The old normal is beginning to look out of place and outdated. But Praise God; in all of these new normal or old normal, our God, Jehovah Almighty remains the same. If we agree with the preceding statement, it then follows that we must watch carefully the decisions we take as they not only affect us here on earth but equally determine where and how we spend eternity. If we are not careful or care less, the decisions and plannings may not have the favorable outcomes we envisage. An elderly man while advising a young man on a life changing decision which may impact his future negatively if he is not careful, said to the young man not to worry about the future but only the present! He should do what pleases and benefits him now! A very dangerous counsel (Job 32:7-8)! Sadly, that is the new world we are living in now. 
      Many people take drastic decisions based on how they presently feel without any regard to what may come. One of the principles that uphold the world and its systems many are forgetting is: “As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, and day and night will not cease” (Genesis 8:22). Meaning, there is a time to plant and a time to harvest what had being sown. Thus, a decision taken today will either impact your future negatively or positively. No wonder we were warned: “Don’t be deceived: God is not mocked. For whatever a man sows he will also reap, because the one who sows to his flesh will reap corruption from the flesh, but the one who sows to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit” (Galatians 6:7-8). There is no escaping this principle. Even those in the world call it ‘Karma’! Therefore, Beloved, as we plan, decide, make arrangements and alliances, do not fall into the mindset of how it should be done in the ‘New Normal’ or based on previous experiences; but make Jesus Christ the Center of your decision making or planning and you will NEVER go wrong. 
      The decisions, planning and so on taken may look and sound foolish to you and to those around you, but if the Lord Jesus Christ is the One leading you, stand on it, and you can bet that it will yield the desired outcome! However, to take decisions, make plans, alliances and arrangements outside of Him, is to sow the wind! Many over the years sowed the wind, now they are reaping the whirlwind (Hosea 8:7). Instead of repenting, they blame and fight everyone else but themselves. Beloved, before taking that drastic life changing decision, step back and ask the Lord for help. Don’t be deceived experience may carry you so far, but vision is guaranteed to take you to a very good end! You may argue that asking people in the world that had been in the same situation for help is much better or your previous experiences will see you through. This is bound to fail you as we approach The Day of the Lord (The Return of Christ). 
      We have entered a time of Separation and Distinction, indeed, a ‘New Normal’ if you will, because it is no longer business as usual in the Spirit realm. A winding down has begun! The devil knows it and has upped his antics. Sadly, sons of God are busy getting very comfortable and forgetting to prepare for His Return. Beloved, last year was a preparation period and a wake-up call! This is the time to make Jesus Christ the very center of your life, from Whom everything in your life flows: “At that time those who feared the Lord spoke to one another. The Lord took notice and listened. So a book of remembrance was written before Him for those who feared Yahweh and had high regard for His name. ‘They will be Mine,’ says the Lord of Hosts, ‘a special possession on the day I am preparing. I will have compassion on them as a man has compassion on his son who serves him. So you will again see the difference between the righteous and the wicked, between one who serves God and one who does not serve Him” (Malachi 3:16-18). This is His sure promise! Beloved, trust and rely on Him every step of the way as He carries you through the year and beyond, and you are guaranteed GOOD SUCCESS! God bless you, in Jesus Christ name!

resources.title: I Am Your Reward
resources.original_resource_body:
Sometimes I wonder what our responses will be if God tells us individually, ‘I will not give you houses, lands, and all other possessions, rather I will be your possession!’ How would we react, would we still serve and follow Him? Would there be a ‘yet’ in our response to Him if we do not get what He had promised (Habakkuk 3:17-18)? If all fail and the way forward is bleak, would we still follow? 
       A young man that was reeling from a devastating loss of all he had was reminded that God is his inheritance and portion; he replied ‘I know, but…!’ The truth is, as sons of the Most High God, He is our REWARD! When we understand this, we can begin to appropriate for ourselves that which has been freely given to us before the foundations of the earth! Sadly, our idea of God being our possession and inheritance is when we can physically see, gauge and hold the ‘possession’ and ‘inheritance’ then it is real! To many children of God, God is good to them based on their earthly possessions. And when they don’t have them, something must be wrong with their beliefs or quality of service to Him. 
       This reminds me of my state many years ago as a young believer in Christ, I wondered then why the Lord did not gift the tribe of Levi their own territory for inheritance as He gifted the other eleven (11) tribes. In a Discipleship Bible Study Class when these Scriptures were read: “The Lord told Aaron, ‘You will not have an inheritance in their land, there will be no portion among them for you. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites’” (Numbers 18:20) and “This will be their inheritance: I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession” (Ezekiel 44:28). Also Deuteronomy 10:8-9 and Revelation 1:6. There was confusion in the hearts of many of us. What did God mean? Are we not to have lands, houses, good things of this life? The questions were numerous and confusing! Sadly, the teacher then could not truly explain to us what the Lord was saying. At the end of the Study, what we could make of it was that this earth is not ours, we should be heavenly minded (which is true by the way), and not think on or imagine to own these things! Like Berean Christians, we went back to the Lord to study! 
       What does this mean for us today? To understand this, as the Lord helps us, let’s go back to the beginning. After Abram and his army of 318 trained men defeated the four kings in Genesis 14, it was clear that Abram was blessed by God in wealth as he turned down the offer from the king of Sodom to have a share in the plunder. Then God spoke to him: “After these things the word of the Lord God came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward” (Genesis 15:1.KJV). This means everything God is and owns is Abrams’! Abram understanding this was confused why he should be childless since the Creator of the Universe is his reward. God showed him: “He took him outside and said, ‘Look at the sky and count the stars, if you are able to count them.’ Then He said to him, ‘Your offspring will be that numerous’” (Genesis 15:5). This blessing came to pass because we are today part of Abraham’s offspring – to as many as believe in Jesus Christ! 
      Beloved, if you have surrendered your life and heart to the Master – becoming His bond-servant, everything He owns is yours and all that you own is His! For instance, in the parable of the Prodigal Son, referring to the son that remained with the father: “’Son’, he said to him, ‘you are always with me, and everything I have is yours…’” (Luke 15:31). Beloved, as a son of God, a bond-servant of Jesus Christ, everything in His House (Kingdom) is yours. Name it: healing, prosperity, greatness, increase, divine health, favor, abundance, enjoyment etc are all yours: “Ask of Me, and I will make the nations your inheritance and the ends of the earth your possession” (Psalm 2:8). If you believe this, then stand up from the seat of despondency and ask the Lord for what you need with a heart of gratitude because it has already been prepared for you: “And my God will supply all your needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus” (Philippians 4:19). 
        Beloved, the wealth of Abraham is beyond the physical, so is our wealth in Christ Jesus. He is ours and we are His; He is our Reward, not because of what we had done, but because of Who He is: “Lord, You are my portion and my cup of blessing; You hold my future. The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, I have a beautiful inheritance” (Psalm 16:5-6). This is our reality! May the Lord help you to walk in this truth and to appropriate for yourself all that had been prepared for you at this time before the foundations of the earth, in Jesus Christ name. God bless you.

resources.normalized_resource_body:
Sometimes I wonder what our responses will be if God tells us individually, ‘I will not give you houses, lands, and all other possessions, rather I will be your possession!’ How would we react, would we still serve and follow Him? Would there be a ‘yet’ in our response to Him if we do not get what He had promised (Habakkuk 3:17-18)? If all fail and the way forward is bleak, would we still follow?

A young man that was reeling from a devastating loss of all he had was reminded that God is his inheritance and portion; he replied ‘I know, but…!’ The truth is, as sons of the Most High God, He is our REWARD! When we understand this, we can begin to appropriate for ourselves that which has been freely given to us before the foundations of the earth! Sadly, our idea of God being our possession and inheritance is when we can physically see, gauge and hold the ‘possession’ and ‘inheritance’ then it is real! To many children of God, God is good to them based on their earthly possessions. And when they don’t have them, something must be wrong with their beliefs or quality of service to Him.

This reminds me of my state many years ago as a young believer in Christ, I wondered then why the Lord did not gift the tribe of Levi their own territory for inheritance as He gifted the other eleven (11) tribes. In a Discipleship Bible Study Class when these Scriptures were read: “The Lord told Aaron, ‘You will not have an inheritance in their land, there will be no portion among them for you. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites’” (Numbers 18:20) and “This will be their inheritance: I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession” (Ezekiel 44:28). Also Deuteronomy 10:8-9 and Revelation 1:6. There was confusion in the hearts of many of us. What did God mean? Are we not to have lands, houses, good things of this life? The questions were numerous and confusing! Sadly, the teacher then could not truly explain to us what the Lord was saying. At the end of the Study, what we could make of it was that this earth is not ours, we should be heavenly minded (which is true by the way), and not think on or imagine to own these things! Like Berean Christians, we went back to the Lord to study!

What does this mean for us today? To understand this, as the Lord helps us, let’s go back to the beginning. After Abram and his army of 318 trained men defeated the four kings in Genesis 14, it was clear that Abram was blessed by God in wealth as he turned down the offer from the king of Sodom to have a share in the plunder. Then God spoke to him: “After these things the word of the Lord God came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward” (Genesis 15:1.KJV). This means everything God is and owns is Abrams’! Abram understanding this was confused why he should be childless since the Creator of the Universe is his reward. God showed him: “He took him outside and said, ‘Look at the sky and count the stars, if you are able to count them.’ Then He said to him, ‘Your offspring will be that numerous’” (Genesis 15:5). This blessing came to pass because we are today part of Abraham’s offspring – to as many as believe in Jesus Christ!

Beloved, if you have surrendered your life and heart to the Master – becoming His bond-servant, everything He owns is yours and all that you own is His! For instance, in the parable of the Prodigal Son, referring to the son that remained with the father: “’Son’, he said to him, ‘you are always with me, and everything I have is yours…’” (Luke 15:31). Beloved, as a son of God, a bond-servant of Jesus Christ, everything in His House (Kingdom) is yours. Name it: healing, prosperity, greatness, increase, divine health, favor, abundance, enjoyment etc are all yours: “Ask of Me, and I will make the nations your inheritance and the ends of the earth your possession” (Psalm 2:8). If you believe this, then stand up from the seat of despondency and ask the Lord for what you need with a heart of gratitude because it has already been prepared for you: “And my God will supply all your needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus” (Philippians 4:19).

Beloved, the wealth of Abraham is beyond the physical, so is our wealth in Christ Jesus. He is ours and we are His; He is our Reward, not because of what we had done, but because of Who He is: “Lord, You are my portion and my cup of blessing; You hold my future. The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, I have a beautiful inheritance” (Psalm 16:5-6). This is our reality! May the Lord help you to walk in this truth and to appropriate for yourself all that had been prepared for you at this time before the foundations of the earth, in Jesus Christ name. God bless you.

resources.title: Truth, Whose Truth?
resources.original_resource_body:
We live in a time where things are not usually as it seems. Things that were held sacred are now being questioned and discarded. Morality and decency has become a matter of perception and not what society holds or should hold dear! We forgot that when the fabrics of decency and morality break down in a community, chaos, fear, uncertainty and unspeakable evil run amok. The Bible described the behavior of these times in this manner: “And because they did not think it worthwhile to have God in their knowledge, God delivered them over to a worthless mind to do what is morally wrong…Although, they know full well God’s just sentence – that those who practice such things deserve to die – they not only do them, but even applaud others who practice them” (Romans 1: 28, 32). 
       Sadly, all these irreverent behavior and more have infiltrated the Church. Instead of bringing more enlightenment as their proponents within the Church thought, it has brought confusion, distress, breed faithlessness, made the people of God more susceptible to manipulations and subject to strange doctrines. Recently, a man of God declared ‘Truth is not absolute; it is all a manner of perception’. Meaning, what can be true to me, may be a lie to someone else depending on where he stands in the argument. He was believed and applauded! If truth is not absolute but a matter of perception, it ceases to be truth. What makes truth Truth is its absoluteness; any other, it is no longer truth no matter the perception or coloration given to it. 
       The world tells us there are many variations of truth. In fact we are encouraged to live our ‘own truth’. Now, that is the world’s system and its precepts, such must not be brought into our lives as sons of God. When we do this, we open our lives up for manipulations and failures. Consider this: If truth is not absolute, then there must not be judgment at the end of life, because what yardstick would God use to judge which is right and which is wrong? But we know as sons of God, that there is one judgment, and GOD is the Righteous Judge! Beloved, God’s word is TRUTH! There are no variations to it. It has never failed from the beginning of creation and is NOT about to fail! We cannot on one hand hold on to God’s Word (as absolute truth) and hold on to the deceptive and manipulative teachings of the world system disguised as the ‘new truth’! It makes it look as if God’s Word is ineffective and inoperable!
       Beloved, God’s Word is powerful and is TRUTH! It has been proven and tested over and over again for centuries and it NEVER failed. It is not about to fail in your life! The false truth may have all the facts and semblance of reality, but it is FALSE and will fail! However, for God’s Word to be effective in your life, you MUST stand with Jesus Christ because He is the ONLY REALITY AND TRUTH: "So, my dear friends, don't get thrown off course. Every desirable ad beneficial gift comes out of heaven. The gifts are rivers of light cascading down from the Father of Light. There is nothing deceitful in God, nothing two-faced, nothing fickle. He brought us to life using the true Word, showing us off as the crown of all His creatures" (James 1:16-18, MSG). 
       The children of Judah were in a similar dilemma, when the king of Syria, Sennacherib, threatened to destroy them (Isaiah 36 and 37). It was true that he destroyed all other countries and their gods that stood against him. Based on the reality on ground, with his wealth and vast army, Judah was minced meat for him to overrun. However, when the people chose to believe and stand with God, the Creator of the heavens and the earth; God sent ONE angel into the enemy's camp, and he killed 185,000 Syrian soldiers in one night. Beloved, Sennacherib’s truth at the time was a lie. The fact that he laid waste to those countries and their gods was not enough for him to lay claim to Judah. 
      Beloved, the weapon of the enemy to advance his lies against you is FEAR (False Events Appearing Real), but you have the Creator of the heavens and the earth in your corner to repel and destroy him! The fact that these ‘truths’ in the account were real only show that God allowed them, if He didn’t they would not have occurred: “Have you not heard? I designed it long ago; I planned it in days gone by, I have now brought it to pass...” (Isaiah 37:26a). The unpleasant happenings in your life may be real but is NOT the truth of God concerning you! Beloved, just as Hezekiah cried to the Lord and He answered him, so is the Lord ready to hear your call. Do not buy into the false truth about your situation; Jesus Christ is only a call away. And He is waiting to hear your voice and leap to your defense. 
       In conclusion, Jesus Christ is coming! He has declared that He IS the Truth, Way and Life. There is no other, and no name given to humans on earth to be saved than His. Don’t allow the disciples of hell masquerading as sons of light deceive you. There is ONLY one Truth, and His name is Jesus Christ! Meaning, anything that negates Him in your life is a lie and not ‘your truth’ or a ‘new truth’. God bless you as you open your heart to Him, in Jesus Christ name!

resources.title: The Way To The Success You Desire Is Jesus
resources.original_resource_body:
We live in a very materialistic world that equates a man’s worth with what he has or has the ability to have. Life incidentally is much more than all of these. As sons of God, our allegiance to God, or the weight of our service should not be based on what we had acquired or could. The world teaches that a man that has not acquired some form of wealth should not be reckoned with. As a result, many believe that they have no credibility if their bank account is not fat. Some go as far as believing that the reason people disrespect them is because of their lack of affluence and influence. However, most of us understand that the Bible has told us that the worth of a man is not based on the size of his wealth, yet, we believe otherwise. Thus, many teachings from pulpits are geared towards us getting as much as we can through strategies, hard work and many other parameters. 
      Sadly, many wonderful sons of God believe that the mark of a man that is blessed is his worth materially. Thus, when they do not have these, they become depressed and begin to drift from the Presence of God! Beloved, allow me under God to call your heart back. When Moses died, God announced to Joshua: “Moses My servant is dead…No one will be able to stand against you as long as you live. I will be with you, just as I was with Moses. I will not leave you or forsake you” (Joshua 1:2a, 5). Then the Lord gave him an instruction that will make the promise a reality in his life: “Above all, be strong and very courageous to carefully observe the whole instruction My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or the left, so that you will have success wherever you go. This book of instruction must not depart from your mouth, you are to recite it day and night, so that you may carefully observe everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in whatever you do” (Joshua 1: 7-8). Joshua followed this instruction and the verdict was: “On that day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they revered him throughout his life, as they had revered Moses” (Joshua 4:14). All Joshua did was to obey the instruction he was given in Chapter 1:6-9, and the Lord held up His end of the covenant. Joshua made his way prosperous and good success dogged his steps. It was not based on his strength but his obedience! 
      Today, sadly, we are told the way to success is based on our abilities and capabilities. If this was so, then God need not watch over us! But He had promised us, as we go for Him: “…And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age” (Matthew 28:20b).  Beloved, everything you need and require for success, and the good one at that, is in Jesus Christ. All He asks of us is to obey and meditate upon His Word; to be CAREFUL TO DO ALL THAT IS WRITTEN. When we do this, we make it possible for Him to make our way prosperous and our steps dogged with success. I say ‘make it possible’ because it is a two way street. We cannot claim the promises of God if we would not obey the instructions attached! If Joshua had not obeyed, he would not have had the respect and reverence of the people. It was not his prosperity that gave him their respect or reverence, God did! If Peter had not listened to the instructions of Jesus that was not a fisherman, but relied on his own acquired ability and capability as a fisherman of many years, he would not have caught the amount of fish he did on both occasions he had clear instructions to cast his net. 
      The Bible tells us: “Remember the Lord your God. He is the One who gives you power to be successful, in order to fulfill the covenant He confirmed to your ancestors with an oath” (Deuteronomy 8:18, NLT). This means the success you have or will have in whatever area of your life is not a product of your power or abilities, but God gives and teaches you how to be. Do not let the world hoodwink you into its vain philosophies (Colossians 2:8), but hold on to God’s clear Word and your way will indeed be successful and prosperous to the glory of God Almighty! Therefore, if there is a prayer verse that must constantly be on our lips in this world as we await the Lord Jesus Christ, it is, Lord, “Turn my eyes from looking at what is worthless; give me life in Your ways” (Psalm 119:37), in Jesus Christ name. God bless you.

resources.title: It’s Not True, Look Up
resources.original_resource_body:
Someone asked recently, are the things happening around the world and in the Body of Christ not strange? Not really! They were foretold long ago. In fact, based on the Scriptures, worse things and more deviant behaviors will increasingly happen as we see the Return of the Lord draw nearer. At the same time, these times will equally herald amazing workings of God among those that believe in Him. In recent times, because of the economic downturn of nations, political uprisings, contagious diseases and the likes, many have lost loved ones, jobs, businesses and homes. Some are going through tough and rough times, and it looks as if God has abandoned His people. This is not true! God is very much with His people! For as many that cry out to Him from a sincere heart and run to Him, He saves! Sadly, instead of running to Him, many do cry to Him but with a heart filled with grumbling, complaints and worrying. He asked us to ask, seek and knock not grumble, complain and worry. Such prayers will not be answered! 
       Beloved, we should not be alarmed at what is happening, the Bible had already told us what will happen and the state of hearts that will be prevalent in these times: “But know this: difficult times will come in the last days. For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy…holding to the form of religion but denying its power…” (2Timothy 3:1-2,5a). Sadly, for as many that succumb to the trappings of this present age are being changed into spiritually bent people! 
       In Luke 13:10-17, Jesus performed a miracle on a woman that was afflicted with a disease that caused her to be bent over for 18 years. She could not look up or raise herself up! Sounds familiar? So many can barely look beyond their pastors, doctrines or self; they are spiritually bent, unable to raise themselves up to see the Lord for themselves! For this woman, one could only imagine the pain she was going through; and very possibly, must have spent all her earnings on trying to get well. For 18 years! I can assure you that at this point she had resigned herself to fate! However, despite her physical limitations and pain, she attended the Service at the Synagogue; and Jesus saw her: “But when Jesus saw her, He called her to Him and said to her, ‘woman, you are loosed from your infirmity’. And He laid His hands on her, and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God” (Luke 13:12-13). 
       When the miracle was questioned by the leader of the Synagogue, Jesus referred to the woman as the daughter of Abraham. Meaning she had a covenant relationship with God. Beloved, because you are a child of God, the covenant made to Abraham covers you as well; it is not just in songs but in reality: “And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you in their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and your descendants after you” (Genesis 17:7); “Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits: Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases, Who redeems your life from destruction” (Psalm 103:2-4a). Her infirmity was not caused by God but by the devil. Jesus referred to it as ‘bondage’. Through it, God displayed His authority over the devil and his works. Jesus declared: “For the Son of Man did not come to destroy men’s lives but to save them…” (Luke 9:56b). 
       Beloved, that which you are going through, and it seems like God had looked away; it is NOT TRUE! He is with you and His intention is not to destroy or harm you, but to save you! By saying she is the daughter of Abraham, Jesus was saying it is her right to be healed and free from the torments of darkness as a child of God. So are you! Beloved, Jesus could have healed her from afar, but He called her to Himself first. In spite of her pain and situation, she obeyed His voice and came to Him. Beloved, understand this: God doesn’t manifest His power because someone has a need! His power is manifested when people have faith in His word and obey! Meaning, your faith in Him and obedience to His word activates that miracle you have been praying for! “Jesus said to him, ‘If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes” (Mark 9:23). God has not abandoned you, ONLY look up past the pain and the worry, in faith and obedience and your miracle awaits you, in Jesus Christ name. God bless you!

In fact, based on the Scriptures, worse things and more deviant behaviors will increasingly happen as we see the Return of the Lord draw nearer. At the same time, these times will equally herald amazing workings of God among those that believe in Him. In recent times, because of the economic downturn of nations, political uprisings, contagious diseases and the likes, many have lost loved ones, jobs, businesses and homes. Some are going through tough and rough times, and it looks as if God has abandoned His people. This is not true! God is very much with His people! For as many that cry out to Him from a sincere heart and run to Him, He saves! Sadly, instead of running to Him, many do cry to Him but with a heart filled with grumbling, complaints and worrying. He asked us to ask, seek and knock not grumble, complain and worry. Such prayers will not be answered!

Beloved, we should not be alarmed at what is happening, the Bible had already told us what will happen and the state of hearts that will be prevalent in these times: “But know this: difficult times will come in the last days. For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy…holding to the form of religion but denying its power…” (2Timothy 3:1-2,5a). Sadly, for as many that succumb to the trappings of this present age are being changed into spiritually bent people!

In Luke 13:10-17, Jesus performed a miracle on a woman that was afflicted with a disease that caused her to be bent over for 18 years. She could not look up or raise herself up! Sounds familiar? So many can barely look beyond their pastors, doctrines or self; they are spiritually bent, unable to raise themselves up to see the Lord for themselves! For this woman, one could only imagine the pain she was going through; and very possibly, must have spent all her earnings on trying to get well. For 18 years! I can assure you that at this point she had resigned herself to fate! However, despite her physical limitations and pain, she attended the Service at the Synagogue; and Jesus saw her: “But when Jesus saw her, He called her to Him and said to her, ‘woman, you are loosed from your infirmity’. And He laid His hands on her, and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God” (Luke 13:12-13).

When the miracle was questioned by the leader of the Synagogue, Jesus referred to the woman as the daughter of Abraham. Meaning she had a covenant relationship with God. Beloved, because you are a child of God, the covenant made to Abraham covers you as well; it is not just in songs but in reality: “And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you in their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and your descendants after you” (Genesis 17:7); “Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits: Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases, Who redeems your life from destruction” (Psalm 103:2-4a). Her infirmity was not caused by God but by the devil. Jesus referred to it as ‘bondage’. Through it, God displayed His authority over the devil and his works. Jesus declared: “For the Son of Man did not come to destroy men’s lives but to save them…” (Luke 9:56b).

Beloved, that which you are going through, and it seems like God had looked away; it is NOT TRUE! He is with you and His intention is not to destroy or harm you, but to save you! By saying she is the daughter of Abraham, Jesus was saying it is her right to be healed and free from the torments of darkness as a child of God. So are you! Beloved, Jesus could have healed her from afar, but He called her to Himself first. In spite of her pain and situation, she obeyed His voice and came to Him. Beloved, understand this: God doesn’t manifest His power because someone has a need! His power is manifested when people have faith in His word and obey! Meaning, your faith in Him and obedience to His word activates that miracle you have been praying for! “Jesus said to him, ‘If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes” (Mark 9:23). God has not abandoned you, ONLY look up past the pain and the worry, in faith and obedience and your miracle awaits you, in Jesus Christ name. God bless you!

resources.title: Take A Stand
resources.original_resource_body:
In the Bible, we saw king Balak of Moab doing everything he can to get Prophet Balaam to curse the people of God (Israel). Balaam declared, how could he curse a people that are blessed, dwelling securely in their tents and beloved of God (Numbers 23 – 24)? Now, the only way for the people to be cursed is if they fall into sin, because a causeless curse cannot rest on a person (Proverbs 26:2). Sadly, fall they did! But Praise God for Phinehas (Aaron’s grandson) that stood his ground against the onslaught of darkness while Moses and the Elders sat. 
       Presently, for the discerning, it is clear that something is happening in the Spirit realm. It is as if we are reliving the Balak and Balaam moments again in the Body of Christ, especially in our Nation. Things that are clearly evil are being celebrated as righteous. We even try to explain away the judgments of God. We see the severe hand of the Lord upon the Church, but we explain it away with Scriptures. It is like the more the Lord warns us, the more sons of God dig their heels deeper in sin! It is not coincidental that the Bible told us: “It is better to go to a house of mourning than to go to a house of feasting, since that is the end of all mankind, and the living should take it to heart” (Ecclesiastes 7:2). This means the occurrence should make you pause and think about your own life; where you will end in eternity! Sadly, many of us at this point find ways to justify the lives and death of the person. Hello! No one made you deputy almighty. No man’s approval or rejection is subject to any human, rather our approval or disapproval is from God: Before Him, we will stand or fall (2Timothy 2:15). If you understand this, you will take heed to your own life as the same fate awaits everyone! 
       Several years ago, many Preachers declared this Scripture boldly from pulpits: “For the time [has arrived] for judgment to begin with the household of God; and if it begins with us, what will [be] the end of those who do not respect or believe or obey the good news (the Gospel) of God?” (1 Peter 4:17 AMPC). They warned and admonished believers to live right and be worthy of the call of God. Many wondered when such a time will be. I remembered a particular Preacher then, declaring that such cannot happen in the next 100 years or so. He posited that this present time is for the Church to reassess herself. He opined that the present state of the Church will not survive if God was to send His judgments. As if God needs our buy-in to send His judgments! Sadly, many that don't know the God they serve were confused with such teachings. But those that know their God, know the coming of Jesus Christ is not just near, it is almost here. 
       If you are still in a state of dilemma, look around you beloved. The world and its systems are going crazy on a daily basis. You don't need to look far to understand why. The enemy has a free reign over the affairs of men because the gatekeepers (the Body of Christ) have left their duty posts! Avarice, greed, inordinate desires, and despicable acts are on the increase because the Church looked away. You might ask, what is the concern of the Church? It is the concern of the Church because we have a mandate and are equipped to spread the light of God around the world to displace and dispel the darkness of hell. We are the light of the world (Matthew 5:14), not a light to ourselves or light under the table! Unfortunately, we are being embarrassed by the actions of some of our brethren daily because we bought into and allowed the evil of the world to seep into the Church: “We are ashamed because we have heard insults. Humiliation covers our faces because foreigners have entered the holy place of the Lord’s temple” (Jeremiah 51:51). 
       Like Phinehas, we must stand up on all our platforms and corners, and declare to the darkness of the world: Enough is Enough! Will you stand up Beloved, in these grave times and be counted for God? Phinehas was grieved in his spirit at the blatant display of evil in the camp of God! To stand for God means to stand against everything of the enemy especially those that have the appearance of good no matter where we find them, and no matter if the Moses’ and Elders of our time are seated! Beloved, you declare everyone is bad at your workplace, how have you become the salt there? Salt, cures, salt heals, salt preserves. What have YOU done as the salt? Light illuminates and dispels, it is clean and righteous!  In your environment...what exactly are you doing to shine the light of God from that corner you occupy? When Phinehas stood, not because he heard a voice tell him to, or he is more righteous than all that was around him but based on what he knew about God, what was transpiring before his eyes were evil. 
       Beloved, based on the teachings you have learned of God, that which you celebrate as good, is it really? For standing up, God blessed Phinehas and his seed forever: “Therefore declare: I grant him My covenant of peace. It will be a covenant of perpetual priesthood for him and his descendants because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites” (Numbers 25:12-13). For us, as we take our stand for the Lord because as we do, we are actually standing for our families, communities, and Nation, God says: “Though the mountains move and the hills shake, My love will not be removed from you and My covenant of peace will not be shaken, says your compassionate LORD” (Isaiah 54:10). It is time to take a stand so that your light shines brightly and true! You and I are the change the Church, Nation needs RIGHT NOW! God bless you as you make the decision to do so!

resources.title: The Law Of Use
resources.original_resource_body:
An associate stated recently that prayers do not work as they should in his life anymore! I was taken aback and it set me thinking. If prayers do not work as they used to, it means, at a point in time they were very effective. It then follows that something must have occurred in that person’s life to cause prayers not to work the way they should. Talking with him, he agreed that he carries the Holy Spirit within him. He just doesn’t feel his prayers are getting to God anymore, he declared, frustrated! Many a time in our lives, we are like the young man. We have prayed consistently about an issue but it looks like the heavens are shut to our cries, yet we are Born Again children of God. Something is not right! I pointed out to him that the desire of God is to commune with us and answer our requests made to Him. Even if we do not quickly see the manifestation of the answers to the prayers, we must have faith that it is done! He was not convinced! 
       Jesus declared to His Disciples (you and I inclusive), “If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you want and it will be done for you…You did not choose Me, but I chose you, I appointed you that you should go out and produce fruit and that your fruit should remain, so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you” (John 15:7 and 16). My associate replied that he had done all that, yet no tangible results to show for it. I was perplexed, to say the least! Then the Holy Spirit whispered in my heart, the Law of Use. Beloved, the Law of Use is a principle that indicates that the more an association is used, the stronger it becomes. Equally, the less an association is used the weaker it becomes! This means for us, when you have something, you don’t use, it becomes useless or when you use it, it becomes stronger! No creature or created thing on earth was created to be useless. Everything has its use! No wonder Jesus told us: “You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt should lose its taste, how can it be made salty? It’s no longer good for anything but to be thrown out and trampled on by men” (Matthew 5:13). This is instructive. A person that loses what he had been given because he did not exercise it will be trampled on by darkness! 
       The Bible went further to tell us: “But solid food is for the mature – for those whose senses have been trained to distinguish between good and evil” (Hebrews 5:14). This means, we need to exercise our senses continually with the Word of God, as we do we grow in maturity. Our faith and Power in Christ Jesus must be exercised so it will continue to grow. If we do not exercise it, the power and the faith we claim to have is useless against the onslaught of the enemy. When the Disciples noticed how Jesus prayed and the immediacy of the results they were astounded. Jesus told them, as He tells us as well: “…Have faith in God. I assure you: If anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea, and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will happen, it will be done for him. Therefore, I tell you, all the things you pray and ask for – believe that you have received them and you will have them” (Mark 11:22-24). 
       Beloved, the prayer is not complete if we do not believe we have received what we asked for. Many times, our minds speak something different from what our lips are saying. If you do not align your minds to what you are asking for, you will not receive. Your mouths may be speaking words of faith but your mind is negating every word. Such a person can never receive answers to their prayers (James 1:6-7). Beloved, take a step back and assess your mind, where is it? If it is speaking contrary to what you are speaking from your mouth as you pray, then there is a problem! No wonder you pray for others, they get results and you are surprised because you are not getting the same in your life! The difference is they BELIEVED! 
       The Bible tells us, if we BELIEVE what we say in prayers, that which we have said will be given to us. You cannot be praying, at the same time wondering when ‘the other shoe will drop’! Prayers are not roulette neither is our God a casino master! Let the meditations of your heart align with the words that come out of your mouth in prayers; believe them and it will be given to you! This we must continue to practice daily. It is not only when you have a need, you remember to pray. Pray always; as you do, your faith is being exercised and built up: “But you, dear friends, building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit” (Jude 1:20). 
       Beloved, it is the desire of God to give you your heart’s desire according to His will. When we pray, we get answers; it may not be the answer we may want, but He will answer nonetheless. But, when we are rooted in Him and pray according to His purpose for us, then it will be exactly and more what we had asked for: “Now this is the confidence we have before Him: whenever we ask anything according to His will, He hears us. And if we know that He hears whatever we ask, we know that we have what we have asked Him for” (1John 5:14-15). God bless you as you re-assess your use of your faith and power in Christ Jesus. May the Heavens open over you and may the Lord grant your requests according to His will and for His glory, in Jesus Christ name, Amen!

resources.title: “How Is Your Walk With The Lord?”
resources.original_resource_body:
I was exchanging pleasantries with a sister I had not seen for quite a while; and she asked me, ‘how is your walk with the Lord?’ I replied, ‘I bless God!’ And we set up a time to meet and catch up. After she left, the question she asked returned to my mind again: ‘how is your walk with the Lord?’ This question is very important as it transcends one’s physical wellbeing to one’s spiritual wellbeing. As sons of God, if we desire to reign with the Lord Jesus Christ when He comes, we must be of sound mind and our walk perfect before Him. We cannot be neither here nor there with Him. No matter what we face on a daily basis, we must be persistent and unwavering in our faith. We were warned by Apostle Paul by the Spirit to: “Examine and test and evaluate your own selves to see whether you are holding to your faith and showing the proper fruits of it. Test and prove yourselves [not Christ]…” (2Corinthians 13:5a, AMP). 
       In our present time, there are so many strange teachings that have given rise to strange behaviors among some members of the Body of Christ that negates the principles of God. If there was ever a time we must be able to sift between the undiluted Word of God and gospel that presents itself as God’s Word, it must be now! The false gospel sounds so true that the lines between it and the True Gospel are getting blurrier by the day! The wisdom and blessing to live in this world and walk perfectly before God has been given to us from the day we said ‘yes’ to Him. The Lord knows without Him, we cannot attain such a feat in a world ruled and filled with darkness. Only in Him can we shine like the stars we have been created to be: “Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavens in Christ; for He chose us in Him, before the foundation of the world, to be holy and blameless in His sight” (Ephesians 1:3-4). 
       When we continue to spend time in His Word, studying and meditating, God trains our ears to hear Him and to see the false before it contaminates us: “[The Servant of God says] The Lord God has given Me the tongue of a disciple and of one who is taught, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him who is weary. He wakens Me morning by morning, He wakens My ear to hear as a disciple [as one who is taught]” (Isaiah 50:4, AMP). However, for God’s Word to take root in us we must purge ourselves of teachings that negate His Word or our hearts will constantly be in conflict with God’s Word. And I can assure you that, it is a matter of time, the negative and nonsensical philosophies of the world and its systems will have an upper hand because the Lord will not struggle with you if you choose to adhere to the other gospel! 
       For us to understand this, let’s consider the parable Jesus told His disciples to counter the Pharisees accusations that His disciples behave contrary to their disciples and that of John the Baptist: “…No one rips up a new garment to make patches for an old, worn-out one. If you tear up the new to make a patch for the old, it would not match the old garment” (Luke 5:36, TPT). This means if you try to fix the teachings and principles of Jesus Christ into what you had learned from the world and its philosophies on how to live, it will leave you deluded! To live Jesus’ way, we must totally surrender and forsake our former way of thinking, which is that of the world. Beloved, don’t be deceived, if you are not living for Jesus Christ, you are living for the world; there is no in-between! That is why we were warned: “See to it that no one carries you off as spoil or makes you yourselves captive by his so-called philosophy and intellectualism and vain deceit (idle fancies and plain nonsense), following human tradition (men’s ideas of the material rather than the spiritual world), just crude notions following the rudimentary and elemental teachings of the universe and disregarding [the teachings of] Christ [the Messiah]” (Colossians 2:8, AMP). 
       Beloved, it is a terrible self-delusion to think you can mix and match the things of God with the things of the world no matter how good they look or sound! The New will always pull away from the old, and the garment (life) will be ruined! Beloved, how is your walk with the Lord? Are you still trying to fit Christ into the system you are operating in? It will only end in disaster. Look at the mirror (Word of God) again and examine yourself, if you are still in faith, walking in step with the Lord! When you look into the mirror you must recognize yourself in Christ: “…Do you not yourselves realize and know [thoroughly by an ever-increasing experience] that Jesus Christ is in you – unless you are [counterfeits] disapproved on trial and rejected” (2Corinthians 13:5b, AMP)? 
       Finally, if what you see is not Christ, then quietly re-assess yourself and readjust. Don’t let the false teachings that masquerade as truth deceive and rob you of your place in Him. But stand in by continuing to draw near to Him: “…And since we have a great high priest over the house of God, let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed in pure water. Let us hold on to the confession of our hope without wavering, for He Who promised is faithful” (Hebrews 10: 21-23). Jesus Christ’s coming is not an “if”, but is a “when”; and He is almost here! Beloved, this is the time to boldly answer ‘I am in step with Him’. May He find you and I in unwavering faith when He returns to take us home, in Jesus Christ name! God bless you.

resources.normalized_resource_body:
I was exchanging pleasantries with a sister I had not seen for quite a while; and she asked me, ‘how is your walk with the Lord?’ I replied, ‘I bless God!’ And we set up a time to meet and catch up. After she left, the question she asked returned to my mind again: ‘how is your walk with the Lord?’ This question is very important as it transcends one’s physical wellbeing to one’s spiritual wellbeing. As sons of God, if we desire to reign with the Lord Jesus Christ when He comes, we must be of sound mind and our walk perfect before Him. We cannot be neither here nor there with Him. No matter what we face on a daily basis, we must be persistent and unwavering in our faith. We were warned by Apostle Paul by the Spirit to: “Examine and test and evaluate your own selves to see whether you are holding to your faith and showing the proper fruits of it. Test and prove yourselves [not Christ]…” (2Corinthians 13:5a, AMP).

In our present time, there are so many strange teachings that have given rise to strange behaviors among some members of the Body of Christ that negates the principles of God. If there was ever a time we must be able to sift between the undiluted Word of God and gospel that presents itself as God’s Word, it must be now! The false gospel sounds so true that the lines between it and the True Gospel are getting blurrier by the day! The wisdom and blessing to live in this world and walk perfectly before God has been given to us from the day we said ‘yes’ to Him. The Lord knows without Him, we cannot attain such a feat in a world ruled and filled with darkness. Only in Him can we shine like the stars we have been created to be: “Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavens in Christ; for He chose us in Him, before the foundation of the world, to be holy and blameless in His sight” (Ephesians 1:3-4).

When we continue to spend time in His Word, studying and meditating, God trains our ears to hear Him and to see the false before it contaminates us: “[The Servant of God says] The Lord God has given Me the tongue of a disciple and of one who is taught, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him who is weary. He wakens Me morning by morning, He wakens My ear to hear as a disciple [as one who is taught]” (Isaiah 50:4, AMP). However, for God’s Word to take root in us we must purge ourselves of teachings that negate His Word or our hearts will constantly be in conflict with God’s Word. And I can assure you that, it is a matter of time, the negative and nonsensical philosophies of the world and its systems will have an upper hand because the Lord will not struggle with you if you choose to adhere to the other gospel!

For us to understand this, let’s consider the parable Jesus told His disciples to counter the Pharisees accusations that His disciples behave contrary to their disciples and that of John the Baptist: “…No one rips up a new garment to make patches for an old, worn-out one. If you tear up the new to make a patch for the old, it would not match the old garment” (Luke 5:36, TPT). This means if you try to fix the teachings and principles of Jesus Christ into what you had learned from the world and its philosophies on how to live, it will leave you deluded! To live Jesus’ way, we must totally surrender and forsake our former way of thinking, which is that of the world. Beloved, don’t be deceived, if you are not living for Jesus Christ, you are living for the world; there is no in-between! That is why we were warned: “See to it that no one carries you off as spoil or makes you yourselves captive by his so-called philosophy and intellectualism and vain deceit (idle fancies and plain nonsense), following human tradition (men’s ideas of the material rather than the spiritual world), just crude notions following the rudimentary and elemental teachings of the universe and disregarding [the teachings of] Christ [the Messiah]” (Colossians 2:8, AMP).

Beloved, it is a terrible self-delusion to think you can mix and match the things of God with the things of the world no matter how good they look or sound! The New will always pull away from the old, and the garment (life) will be ruined! Beloved, how is your walk with the Lord? Are you still trying to fit Christ into the system you are operating in? It will only end in disaster. Look at the mirror (Word of God) again and examine yourself, if you are still in faith, walking in step with the Lord! When you look into the mirror you must recognize yourself in Christ: “…Do you not yourselves realize and know [thoroughly by an ever-increasing experience] that Jesus Christ is in you – unless you are [counterfeits] disapproved on trial and rejected” (2Corinthians 13:5b, AMP)?

Finally, if what you see is not Christ, then quietly re-assess yourself and readjust. Don’t let the false teachings that masquerade as truth deceive and rob you of your place in Him. But stand in by continuing to draw near to Him: “…And since we have a great high priest over the house of God, let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed in pure water. Let us hold on to the confession of our hope without wavering, for He Who promised is faithful” (Hebrews 10: 21-23). Jesus Christ’s coming is not an “if”, but is a “when”; and He is almost here! Beloved, this is the time to boldly answer ‘I am in step with Him’. May He find you and I in unwavering faith when He returns to take us home, in Jesus Christ name! God bless you.
